experiment: Meshy.ai commercial-safe rigged characters — closing the Geno licence gap
mission: Founder: meshy subscription + 'the Geno MESH is research-only' (docs/20 §6). Generate stylized athletic characters, auto-rig to mixamo, verify our mocap clips play by world-position deltas, put them on /avatars as the commercial-safe base.
api: https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2 (text-to-3d) + /openapi/v1 (rigging, balance). Harness: meshy.py (reused from the 08-31 frog experiment).
api_notes: art_style is DEPRECATED (docs.meshy.ai): only realistic/sculpture, ignored by Meshy-6+. 'Stylized' was therefore carried in the PROMPT wording, not art_style.

pose_mode 't-pose' works; should_remesh:true + target_polycount:100000 bakes the remesh into the preview (rig needs ≤320k faces) — one step fewer than the 08-31 pipeline (which needed a separate /v1/remesh call).
Rig output: standard mixamo skeleton + basic walk/run GLBs (basic_animations) — same shape as the frog run.

Stylized video game character asset: athletic humanoid with balanced proportioned muscles, plain grey training t-shirt, dark neutral shorts, simple trainers, neutral confident stance, arms straight out in a T pose, clean smooth game-ready shapes, clean silhouette, full body visible

integration.retargeter: site/model-avatars.js BVHPlayer is name-based; the three characters needed exactly the standard Meshy rename (rename_bones.py) — no other mapping.

regression_fix.what: rename_bones.py wrote the GLB JSON chunk with chunkLength = raw bytes and placed the 0x20 alignment padding AFTER the declared chunk. three.js walks chunks strictly sequentially (skip 8+chunkLength), so the BIN header was read 1–3 bytes early, body stayed null, and EVERY load rejected with "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'slice')".
regression_fix.impact: site/models/meshy_frog_full.glb was corrupt the same way since 2026-08-31 — the /avatars 'Frog — meshy.ai rigged' card has been silently BLANK since the last session (loadModel promise rejects; the card builder has no catch). The 08-31 manifest's 'card renders + poses' claim predates the rename install or was taken from a cached pre-rename build — this session re-verified from scratch.
regression_fix.fix: padding is now INSIDE the declared chunkLength (+ 4-alignment assert). Original script archived at meshy/archive/rename_bones_pre_fix_20260908.py. meshy_frog_full.glb regenerated from the untouched A_rigged.glb.
regression_fix.post_fix_proof: browser load ok:true for frog + all three new characters; frog card ok:true with BVH walk playing (bvhT 0.82); /avatars + /atelier console errors = 0.

harnesses: apps/avatars/test/meshy2_verify.ts (two-frame world-position deltas per clip + NaN gate + pose phases)
apps/avatars/test/meshy2_shots.ts (card inventory via __rwfModels + shots + console watch)

notes: Rigged GLBs carry Meshy's own walk/run ('Armature|clip0|baselayer') — unused; our BVH/JSON mocap retargets by joint name onto the mixamo skeleton.
Characters are textured, NOT tinted (real PBR, like the frog) — no palette treatment.

Heavyweight/sprinter ship with 8-clip mocap lists (walk/run/idle/demo_walk/sprint/swagger/agree/sad) — the full 16-clip Geno list can be added per card later; exercise poses ride ModelAvatar.pose for every mixamo card already ('exercise' button).
Console: 0 errors on /avatars and /atelier after the fix (CDP Runtime.consoleAPICalled + Log.entryAdded + exceptionThrown capture).
Meshy asset retention: task outputs expire (signed URLs) — local GLBs in site/models/ are canonical now.
